title: decree daemon --once --dry-run --format json
description: What `decree daemon --once --dry-run --format json` prints on stdout: the inbox messages, in the order `daemon --once` would take them, with their machines. Errors go to stderr; with any, the exit code is 1 and nothing would run. `--format` is only for --dry-run: `daemon` itself produces a stream. Reference: docs/reference/cli.md, Machine-readable output.

inbox.description: Messages in inbox/, in filename order.

valid.description: False when the message fails M2; its errors go to stderr and nothing would run.

machine.description: The machine the message would run through, for a valid message without `to:`.

to.description: The wait id or run id a reply (a message with `to:`) would be delivered to.
